_comment: User stories of the journeys J1 to J4: what a reader acting in a role wants. Schema: cat-harness/schemas/user-story.ts.
name: smart-trust-demo

stories.want: Have my son's birth doses from abroad recognised at home
stories.soThat: his care does not start over and nothing is repeated

stories.want: Show each family member's records abroad from our one shared phone, with a passcode I can say aloud
stories.soThat: a doctor abroad can treat us without paper or an app

stories.want: Decide who sees my child's record, and for how long
stories.soThat: the record stays at home and I know who has looked

stories.want: Print a signed record of each birth dose the family can carry anywhere
Read a foreign vaccination QR offline and register the child with it
stories.soThat: the clinic sees what was given before the family arrives

stories.want: Refer a child whose foreign record needs checking
stories.soThat: verification is done by someone who can

stories.want: Register a newborn into the household offline, before civil registration
stories.soThat: no newborn in my village is missed, even with no signal

stories.want: Know whether a foreign certificate is genuine, and why not when it is not
See which doses are due once the foreign doses are imported
stories.soThat: I give only what is missing

stories.want: Keep the foreign vaccine code and add our schedule code beside it, deciding myself when there is no match
stories.soThat: the other country's record is never overwritten and the next nurse need not decide again

stories.want: Read a visiting child's summary and vaccinations from a QR the parent shows
stories.soThat: without installing anything or calling another country

stories.want: Know the record I read abroad came from the child's home country and was not altered
stories.soThat: I can rely on it as I would on my own clinic's record
